title: Privacy
description: What inzumer.com collects, why and how to change it.
intro: This site belongs to Nahuel Zamuner. It collects as little as possible, and nothing you don't agree to.

sections.title: Preferences
sections.text: Your theme, language and cookie choice are saved in this browser (local storage). They never leave your device.

sections.title: Visits and performance
sections.text: Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights count visits and measure loading speed without cookies and without identifying you.

sections.title: Google Analytics
sections.text: Only if you accept it: pages visited, clicks on buttons and links, device and approximate location, to see which projects interest people. It uses Google cookies (_ga), without ad signals. You can withdraw it any time.

sections.title: Contact form
sections.text: Your name, email and message reach me by email through Resend, only to answer you. You also get a confirmation. The site keeps no copy.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: To see, correct or delete your data, write to inzumer@gmail.com.
